# SINGULANCE

> The AI operating layer for regulated Europe. Run your institution as an AI company.

SINGULANCE is a sovereign, GDPR-native AI workforce that runs inside an organization's memory. It is built for regulated European institutions (finance, healthcare, government, enterprise) that need autonomous AI which remembers, reasons, and acts — without sending data outside their walls.

Slogan: "Beyond the horizon of intelligence." Tagline: "AI workforce that runs inside memory."

Primary domain: https://singulancelabs.com (also served on https://davinciai.eu). Also known as: SINGULANCE AI, Singulance, Singulance AI.

## Products

- [TARA](https://singulancelabs.com/): Enterprise voice agent that reasons in real time (not a script that retrieves). Handles calls, lead qualification, appointment booking, and support with multilingual natural language understanding. Sub-500ms responses.
- [HIVEMIND](https://singulancelabs.com/): Sovereign memory engine. Sub-50ms semantic recall across everything an organization knows. Graph-based knowledge storage, cross-agent memory sharing, MCP integration for AI assistants (Claude, etc.). GDPR / DPDP compliant data residency.
- [HYPERAGENTS](https://singulancelabs.com/hivemind/app/employees): A swarm of digital employees — multiple AI agents that watch, decide, and act as one, coordinated and grounded in HIVEMIND memory, running inside the organization's own infrastructure.

## Why SINGULANCE

Today's AI is amnesiac: it dazzles for a session, then forgets. SINGULANCE solves the memory, continuity, and coordination problems so intelligence stops being a feature you rent and becomes a presence you keep — sovereign, sub-50ms, and compliant by design.

## Capabilities

- Sovereign, GDPR/DPDP-compliant data residency — data stays in compliant EU infrastructure.
- Sub-50ms semantic recall — retrieve by meaning, not keywords.
- Graph-based memory — entities, relationships, and knowledge graphs persisted across sessions.
- Cross-agent memory sharing — many agents share one memory cortex.
- MCP integration — expose memory and tools to any MCP-compatible AI assistant.
- Real-time reasoning voice — TARA processes intent, meaning, root problem, and optimal path in parallel.
- Multi-agent coordination — HYPERAGENTS act as one autonomous digital workforce.

## FAQ

### What is SINGULANCE?
SINGULANCE is the AI operating layer for regulated Europe — a sovereign, GDPR-native AI workforce that runs inside an organization's memory, via three products: TARA (voice), HIVEMIND (sovereign memory), and HYPERAGENTS (agent swarm).

### What is HIVEMIND?
HIVEMIND is SINGULANCE's sovereign memory engine with sub-50ms semantic recall, graph-based knowledge storage, cross-agent memory sharing, and MCP integration. GDPR / DPDP compliant.

### What is TARA?
TARA is SINGULANCE's enterprise voice agent that reasons in real time to handle calls, scheduling, and support with multilingual natural language understanding.

### What is HYPERAGENTS?
HYPERAGENTS is SINGULANCE's swarm of digital employees — AI agents that coordinate to watch, decide, and act as one, grounded in HIVEMIND memory.

### Is SINGULANCE GDPR compliant?
Yes. SINGULANCE is sovereign and GDPR / DPDP compliant by design, with EU data residency, built for regulated European institutions.
